article.title: Bioinputs school in China: Global South could meet up to 50% of fertiliser demand with organic waste
article.author: Editor
article.content: For decades, China was the world's largest consumer of chemical fertilisers, using approximately 50 million tonnes per year, according to the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS). Today, according to FAO data, it is the only country that has reduced its consumption. The post Bioinputs school in China: Global South could meet up to 50% of fertiliser demand with organic waste appeared first on MR Online .
